title: Emergent alignment and the projectability of ethical personas
abstract: arXiv:2606.09475v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Work on `emergent misalignment' shows that finetuning LLMs on narrow tasks can induce broadly misaligned behavior. This supports the `persona selection' (PSM) hypothesis: during pre-training, LLMs learn to simulate different characters/perspectives, which can be elicited and refined during post-training. This paper investigates the converse phenomenon, `emergent alignment', and uses it to support and refine the PSM and motivate a novel desideratum for alignment. We finetune a helpful-only model on broad and narrow safety tasks. To create SFT samples, we follow the `Constitutional AI' (CAI) approach and use four constitutions which encode reasonable alignment strategies: deontology, consequentialism, virtue ethics, and aligning AIs as subordinate to human authority. translated_title: 涌现对齐与伦理人格的可投射性
translated_abstract: 关于“涌现失准”的研究表明，在大语言模型上针对狭窄任务进行微调可能引发广泛的对齐偏差行为。这支持了“人格选择”假说（PSM）：在预训练期间，大语言模型学会了模拟不同的角色/视角，这些角色/视角可以在后训练过程中被激发和优化。本文研究了相反的现象——“涌现对齐”，并利用它来支持和完善人格选择假说，同时为对齐研究提出一个新的目标。研究者在仅具助人功能的模型上，针对宽泛和狭窄的安全任务进行微调。为了创建监督微调（SFT）样本，他们遵循“宪法式AI"（CAI）方法，使用了四种编码合理对齐策略的宪法：义务论、后果主义、美德伦理，以及将AI对齐为从属于人类权威。对于每一种宪法，他们都证明了在两个狭窄的安全子类别上进行微调，能够可靠地在具有代表性的一般安全类别集合上引发涌现对齐，并且在……（摘要此处截断）
tldr: 本文通过用四种伦理宪法（义务论、后果主义、美德伦理和AI从属人类权威）在狭窄安全任务上微调大语言模型，证明能够可靠地引发广泛的“涌现对齐”现象，从而支持并完善了“人格选择”假说，并为对齐研究提出了“伦理人格的可投射性”这一新目标。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that finetuning LLMs on narrow safety tasks using four constitutions encoding distinct ethical strategies (deontology, consequentialism, virtue ethics, and AI subordination to human authority) reliably induces broad "emergent alignment," supporting the persona selection hypothesis and motivating the "projectability of ethical personas" as a novel desideratum for alignment.
